learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge to describe the basic properties of renewable energy sources.
Be able to characterize individual types of renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, water, etc.
Explain the principles of using alternative energy sources and biomass and their application.
Explain the energy use and combination of renewable sources and the basic balance.
Explain the use of SMART and LCA analysis for application in the energy sector.
Be able to correctly evaluate the positive and negative aspects of selected technologies using renewable and alternative energy sources, including their pitfalls and limitations.
Determine and calculate the basic energy balance, efficiency and possibly also the economic evaluation for basic types of renewable energy sources.
Recommend a suitable combination of two or more energy sources for specific applications.
Acquire basic knowledge and an overview of renewable energy sources and their use.
Understand current trends and pressure for the share in the application of renewable energy sources and the circular economy.
Be capable to implement and take into account ecological aspects of a global nature in their future professional career.
Gain awareness that it is also possible to use non-traditional solutions and alternative energy sources.

syllabus_topics: Energy: types, sources, transformations, assessment. Basic balance.
Energy, energy consumption and reserves, waste energy. Energy mix.
Use of low-potential heat of natural materials using heat pumps.
Alternative energy sources, fuel cells, hydrogen.
Biomass as a renewable energy source.
Transformation of secondary raw materials and their potential in energy.
Use of the SMART and LCA methods.
